prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Your Desktop Companion", "Select your favorite pet personality archetype and hear their signature sound before adoption.", "Listen to sound samples to pick the right companion temperament.", "Play Pet Sound"]
1: ["Preparing Your Companion Asset Bundle", "Your pet is being configured in the background. Take a preview look at your desktop placement.", "Preview Desktop Placement"]
2: ["Master Your Pet Desktop Controls", "Learn how to summon, hide, and interact with your pet right from your desktop system tray.", "Try right-clicking the tray icon"]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Creation Journey", "Select whether to adopt a pre-made archetype or create a custom pet from your photos."]
4: ["Upload Photos for Ideal Pet Generation", "Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward to avoid visual defects during 3D pet generation.", "Ensure single subject facing light with minimal background clutter for best results."]
5: ["Secure Your Pet Account & Sync Data", "Sign in to keep your pet settings across devices and prevent losing your pet companion status.", "Your pet progress and customization will be backed up automatically.", "Cloud Protection Active"]
6: ["Desktop Rendering in Progress", "We will notify you with a gentle sound chime as soon as your pet is live on your screen.", "Play Chime Test"]
7: ["Your Pet Is Now Live On Screen", "Right-click the system tray icon to open controls, toggle visibility, or chat with your pet.", "Look for the pet icon next to your desktop system clock.", "Got It!"]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Pick Instant Adoption for ready-made companions or Custom Studio for unique photo generation.", "Instant Setup (Ready in 30s)", "Custom AI Generation (Photo-Based)"]
9: ["Sign Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a name and receive your official digital ownership certificate.", "Companion Name", "Official Digital Seal"]
